description: This file defines the EnumConfigField class, which extends BaseConfigField and manages a UI component (JComboBox) for selecting among enumerated options for a configuration field. It includes logic for initializing options, handling messages from MessagesCentral, and sending updates when the selection changes.

classes.name: EnumConfigField
classes.description: A UI component for editing enum-type configuration fields, supporting dynamic updates and message-based synchronization.

methods.name: EnumConfigField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the enum options, sets up UI components, and registers message listeners.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the selected item in the combo box based on the provided ordinal value.

methods.name: loadValue
methods.description: Loads the ordinal value from a ConfigurationImage and updates the UI accordingly.
